# Auth Token: Get an Account Owner Scoped Bearer Token

Area overview and notes: [auth-token.md](../auth-token.md)

`POST /oauth/account-owner-token` · no token

This token serves as the authorization mechanism enabling you to submit and access Tax Documentation on behalf of the account owner. It is specifically designed for use with Account Owner and Tax Documentation endpoints and is primarily employed by customers using the Taxbit W8/W9 solution.

**Request body** (required, JSON)

**Shape 1: Bearer Token Request**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `client_id` | string | Yes | Your Taxbit authentication client_id. |
| `client_secret` | string | Yes | Your Taxbit authentication client_secret. |
| `grant_type` | string | Yes | OAuth 2.0 grant_type. The only supported value at this time is client_credentials. |
| `id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the account owner. |
| `tenant_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The tenant that the account owner is part of. |

**Shape 2: Bearer Token Request (Deprecated)**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `client_id` | string | Yes | Your Taxbit authentication client_id. |
| `client_secret` | string | Yes | Your Taxbit authentication client_secret. |
| `grant_type` | string | Yes | OAuth 2.0 grant_type. The only supported value at this time is client_credentials. |
| `account_owner_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The Taxbit ID of the Account Owner. **Deprecated.** |
| `tenant_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The tenant that the account owner is part of. |

Example request body:

```json
{"id":"JohnDoe864","client_id":"<client_id>","client_secret":"<client_secret>","grant_type":"client_credentials","tenant_id":"8d0bd177-dd48-4bea-b89e-c4ce038375e7"}
```

**Response 200**: Account owner token

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `access_token` | string | Yes | Bearer token to use on behalf of an Account Owner to access and modify their Tax Documentation. |
| `expires_in` | integer | Yes | Time until token expires (in seconds). |
| `token_type` | string | Yes | Access token type. |
| `scope` | string | No |  |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 401 Unauthorized · 403 Forbidden · 429 Too Many Requests
